_note: Our own writing. Talking terms mid-battle with the enemy commander (Rivals): the book says surrender and retreat are valid ends to a fight, and the GM may end it early once the outcome isn't in question (Core p.60). Opened by the commander (StoryEngine battle_events) or by the squad (parley).

demand.speaker: pilot
line: {rival}, it's over. Stand down.
Look around, {rival}. You've lost. Let's end this.
This is your one chance, {rival}. Tell your people to power down.

text: Power down and climb out. You'll be treated fairly.
Accepted. Stand down, and nobody else gets hurt.
Deal. Hands where we can see them.

effects.reason: {rival}'s force stood down. The field is yours (Core p.60: surrender ends a fight).

text: Take your people and go. Don't come back.
Leave the field and we're done here.
Go. Before I change my mind.

effects.reason: {rival} withdrew and the field is yours (Core p.60: retreat ends a fight).

text: Tell us what you know, and you can walk.

check.consequence: They leave without telling you anything useful, and they won't forget being pushed.

accepted.speaker: narrator
line: The enemy mechs power down one by one. It's over.
Hatches open. Hands go up. The fight is over.
Weapons go quiet across the field. They've surrendered.

let_go.speaker: narrator
line: The enemy pulls back and is gone. The field is yours.
You watch them go until they're off your sensors.
They withdraw in good order. Nobody fires.

intel_ok.speaker: narrator
line: {rival} talks, quickly, then leaves. What they told you checks out (Knowledge reserve).
It's useful: names, places, a schedule (Knowledge reserve). Then they're gone.

intel_bad.speaker: narrator
line: {rival} gives you nothing but a look you'll remember, and leaves.
They walk without a word. That one will be back.

deal_done.speaker: narrator
line: {rival} keeps their side of it (Knowledge reserve), and their mechs slip away.
The information comes through as promised (Knowledge reserve). So does their retreat.

withdrawn.speaker: narrator
line: The squad pulls back, carrying its wounded. Nobody fires.
You withdraw. It stings, but everyone who's still alive stays alive.

truce.speaker: narrator
line: A long silence. Then both sides back away.
Nobody wins. Everybody lives. Both sides pull back.
